title: Pan-Seared Fish with Bitter Fritters
description: A classic French dish featuring pan-seared fish served with crispy bitter fritters and a side of fluffy rice.

ingredients.name: Fish fillets
ingredients.notes: White fish such as cod or tilapia

instructions: Season fish fillets with saudia spice blend
Pan-sear fish in stir-fry oil for 3-4 minutes per side
Bake fish in oven for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through
Mix fluffy rice with chopped bitter greens
Prepare fry batter and dip bitter greens in batter
Fry bitter greens in stir-fry oil until crispy
Serve pan-seared fish with crispy bitter fritters and fluffy rice
